name: domiciliation-monorepo
description: Monorepo pour GOOD START DOMICILIATION + LMC Formation

scripts.build:all: npm run build:front && npm run build:lmc
scripts.deploy: npm run build:all && pm2 restart domiciliation-api
scripts.deploy:full: npm run build:all && cd /etc/nginx/sites-enabled && sudo ln -sf /var/www/domiciliation/nginx/domiciliation.conf && sudo nginx -t && sudo systemctl reload nginx && pm2 restart domiciliation-api
